query: Do you tip in restaurants in Japan?
answer: No, you don't tip in restaurants in Japan. It isn't expected, the menu price already covers the service, and leaving money on the table can confuse staff. Servers sometimes chase customers down to hand back money they think was forgotten [1][2]. Some upscale restaurants and hotels add a service charge of about 10–15%, which will be listed on the bill, and you don't need to add anything on top of it [1][3]. At izakaya (Japanese pubs) and bars you may also see an "otoshi" charge for a small appetizer served automatically, or a seating charge. These are set fees, not tips [3]. The usual way to show thanks is to say so, for example "gochisōsama deshita" as you leave [1][2].
